mission_objective: Compare three local café competitors’ pricing, menu positioning, and Instagram presence to inform SAHAKON’s next 30-day promo.
desired_outcome: Owner can choose one promo angle with evidence from three competitors.
success_criteria: Three competitors covered on pricing, menu positioning, and IG presence
One recommended 30-day promo angle with two risks
final_deliverable: One-page competitor recommendation memo for SAHAKON 30-day promo

explicit_assumptions.text: Competitors are the top three nearby cafés by typical foot traffic unless Owner names others.
Instagram presence means public posts from the last 30 days.
Thai or English memo is acceptable.

reasoning_actions.action: Collect competitor pricing, menu themes, and IG cadence
Recommend one 30-day promo angle with risks

workstreams.title: Collect competitor pricing, menu, and IG facts
workstreams.objective: Gather structured facts for three cafés: price bands, menu positioning themes, and Instagram posting cadence/content themes.

expected_output.description: Competitor fact table with pricing, menu themes, IG cadence

acceptance_criteria: Each row includes pricing, menu theme, and IG signal

workstreams.title: Build SAHAKON-versus-competitor matrix
workstreams.objective: Turn the fact table into a comparison matrix scoring positioning opportunities for SAHAKON.

expected_output.description: Comparison matrix of three competitors vs SAHAKON

acceptance_criteria: Matrix covers pricing, menu, and IG dimensions
SAHAKON row or column is explicit

workstreams.title: Write one-page 30-day promo recommendation
workstreams.objective: Produce the Owner-facing one-page memo with one recommended promo angle and two risks grounded in the matrix.

expected_output.description: One-page competitor recommendation memo for SAHAKON 30-day promo
